steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure a reverse buy auction with a price-based strategy and lot awarding.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the first product line item before clearing its requested quantity.
Clear the first row's requested quantity to reproduce the blank-quantity case.
Verify the sheet marks the blank quantity as invalid or required.
Add the available QA test vendor so quantity is the remaining publish blocker.
